definitions.explanation: The eastern region of Japan's main island, including Tokyo and surrounding prefectures.

examples.japanese: {関東|かんとう}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a large earthquake in the Kanto region.

examples.japanese: {関東|かんとう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The culture differs between Kanto and Kansai.

examples.japanese: {関東|かんとう}⟦{平野|へいや}→平野：00096_heiya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{平野|へいや}→平野：00096_heiya⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The Kanto Plain is the largest plain in Japan.

notes:
{関東|かんとう} refers to the eastern region of Honshu centered around Tokyo.

Prefectures included:
- ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦{都|と}→都：noentry⟧ (Tokyo)
- ⟦{神奈川|かながわ}→神奈川：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Kanagawa - Yokohama)
- ⟦{千葉|ちば}→千葉：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Chiba)
- ⟦{埼玉|さいたま}→埼玉：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Saitama)
- ⟦{茨城|いばらき}→茨城：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Ibaraki)
- ⟦{栃木|とちぎ}→栃木：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Tochigi)
- ⟦{群馬|ぐんま}→群馬：noentry⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (Gunma)

Common expressions:
- {関東|かんとう}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ (Kanto region)
- {関東|かんとう}⟦{平野|へいや}→平野：00096_heiya⟧ (Kanto Plain)
- {関東|かんとう}⟦{大震災|だいしんさい}→大震災：noentry⟧ (Great Kanto Earthquake of 1923)

Opposite region:
- ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧ (Kansai - Osaka area)
